arguments.argument:
gen="${project.build.directory}/generated-sources/xjc" # PROVE THE GATE IS OPERATIVE BEFORE TRUSTING ITS GREEN. `grep -r` on a missing # directory prints a warning, exits non-zero, and `|| true` swallows it -- so the # unguarded form reports "0 hits" and passes when XJC's output moves. A gate that # cannot tell "clean" from "nothing to check" is not a gate. if [ ! -d "$gen" ]; then echo "GATE INOPERATIVE: $gen does not exist." echo "XJC's output directory moved, or codegen was skipped. Point this gate at" echo "the jaxb-maven-plugin <generateDirectory>; do not delete the check." exit 1 fi n=$(find "$gen" -name '*.java' | wc -l) if [ "$n" -lt 3000 ]; then echo "GATE INOPERATIVE: only $n generated .java files under $gen (expect ~4450)." exit 1 fi fixed="${project.basedir}/src/main/java" seam="${project.basedir}/src/main/java-${netex.schema.version}" for r in "$fixed" "$seam"; do if [ ! -d "$r" ]; then echo "GATE INOPERATIVE: hand-written source root $r does not exist." exit 1 fi done
# OURS, READ OFF THE FILESYSTEM. A hand-written list here would go stale the # first time an adapter is added or removed, and a stale allowlist fails in the # permissive direction. ours=$(find "$fixed/noi/netex/xml" -name '*.java' -printf '%f\n' \ | sed 's/\.java$//' | sort) if [ "$(echo "$ours" | wc -w)" -lt 2 ]; then echo "GATE INOPERATIVE: found $(echo "$ours" | wc -w) adapter(s) under" echo "$fixed/noi/netex/xml -- the allowlist would be empty or near-empty and" echo "this gate would fail everything or nothing. Did the package move?" exit 1 fi oursAlt=$(echo "$ours" | paste -sd'|')
# The two jakarta adapters XJC installs CORRECTLY, plus the annotation and the # base class every adapter names. Everything else is foreign. jakartaOk='XmlAdapter|XmlJavaTypeAdapter|CollapsedStringAdapter|HexBinaryAdapter'
# THE GENERATED ARM. XJC refers to an adapter by simple name and imports it, so # the import lines are the complete census of what the generated model binds # through. bad=$(grep -rhoE '^import [A-Za-z0-9_.]*Adapter;' "$gen" \ | sed -e 's/^import //' -e 's/;$//' | sort -u \ | grep -vE "^noi\.netex\.xml\.($oursAlt)$" \ | grep -vE "^jakarta\.xml\.bind\.annotation\.adapters\.($jakartaOk)$" \ || true) if [ -n "$bad" ]; then echo "FOREIGN ADAPTER IN GENERATED SOURCE — a javaType binding did not take." echo "This module binds through noi.netex.xml.* only. Fix the matching" echo "<xjc:javaType> in model/src/main/xjb/; do NOT relax this gate." echo "Offending adapters:" echo "$bad" | sed 's/^/ /' for b in $bad; do echo " named by: $(grep -rl "import $b;" "$gen" | wc -l) generated file(s)" done exit 1 fi
# THE HAND-WRITTEN ARM. Reading generated sources ONLY leaves a foreign adapter # typed by hand under src/main/java -- the very directory that holds # noi.netex.xml -- invisible. jakarta's NormalizedStringAdapter IS on this # module's compile classpath, so a hand-written carrier could delegate to the # whitespace-replace behaviour the xjb binding exists to suppress, and every # generated field would still name only noi.netex.xml. # # Scope: main sources only, both the fixed root and the version-selected seam # root. src/test/java is deliberately EXCLUDED -- AdaptersTest names jakarta's # NormalizedStringAdapter on purpose, as the oracle for the defect # VerbatimStringAdapter exists to avoid, and a gate that fires on its own test # fixtures is one people switch off. # # Comment lines are filtered out: javadoc here legitimately names the adapters # these classes exist to replace, and saying so is worth more than an exact-match # grep. The filter drops `*`, `//` and `/*` lines only, so a trailing # end-of-line comment still trips the gate -- deliberately the safe direction. # # The comment filter has to run on WHOLE LINES, before any token extraction -- # `grep -o` would hand the filter a bare token with the `///` already gone, and # the filter would then pass every javadoc mention through. So: grep -n for # candidate lines, drop the comment ones, and only then pick tokens out of what # survives, in awk, with the `file:line:` prefix held aside so a filename ending # in Adapter.java cannot be mistaken for a reference. hw="" for r in "$fixed" "$seam"; do hw="$hw$(grep -rnE '[A-Za-z0-9_.]*Adapter' "$r" --include='*.java' \ | grep -vE ':[0-9]+:[[:space:]]*(\*|//|/\*)' \ | awk -v ok="^($oursAlt|$jakartaOk)\$" ' { loc = ""; if (match($0, /^[^:]+:[0-9]+:/)) { loc = substr($0, 1, RLENGTH); $0 = substr($0, RLENGTH + 1); } while (match($0, /[A-Za-z0-9_.]*Adapter/)) { tok = substr($0, RSTART, RLENGTH); $0 = substr($0, RSTART + RLENGTH); simple = tok; sub(/^noi\.netex\.xml\./, "", simple); sub(/^jakarta\.xml\.bind\.annotation\.adapters\./, "", simple); # anything still package-qualified is from somewhere else if (simple ~ /\./ || simple !~ ok) print loc tok; } }' \ || true)" done hwn=$(find "$fixed" "$seam" -name '*.java' | wc -l) if [ "$hwn" -lt 5 ]; then echo "GATE INOPERATIVE: only $hwn hand-written .java files (expect ~14)." exit 1 fi if [ -n "$hw" ]; then echo "FOREIGN ADAPTER IN HAND-WRITTEN SOURCE — outside comments, under src/main." echo "This module's adapters are noi.netex.xml.*; outside a comment nothing here" echo "may name an adapter that is not one of those or a correct jakarta one" echo "($jakartaOk)." echo "$hw" | head -20 exit 1 fi echo "[gate] $n generated + $hwn hand-written sources bind through noi.netex.xml only" echo "[gate] allowlist (from the filesystem): $(echo $ours)"

base="${project.basedir}/src/main" sel="$base/java-${netex.schema.version}" if [ ! -d "$sel" ]; then echo "NO SEAM SOURCE ROOT FOR netex.schema.version=${netex.schema.version}:" echo " expected $sel" echo " This root holds the version-selected accessor seams:" echo " noi.netex.text.Mls (MultilingualString becomes a mixed type at 2.0)" echo " and noi.netex.calls.Calls (2.0 dissolves the Call_ substitution group)." echo " build-helper add-source on a missing directory is a SILENT no-op, which" echo " is why this is a build failure and not a warning." exit 1 fi roots=$(find "$base" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'java-*' | sort) nroots=$(echo "$roots" | grep -c .) missing="" if [ "$nroots" -ge 2 ]; then for r in $roots; do for f in $(cd "$r" && find . -name '*.java' | sed 's|^\./||' | sort); do if [ ! -f "$sel/$f" ]; then missing="$missing $f (present in ${r##*/}, absent for ${netex.schema.version})" fi done done fi if [ -n "$missing" ]; then echo "SEAM CLASS WITHOUT A BODY FOR netex.schema.version=${netex.schema.version}:$missing" echo "" echo "Every seam class needs one body per schema version and ONE public surface." echo "Write the missing file under $sel; do not delete it from the other root." exit 1 fi nseam=$(find "$sel" -name '*.java' | wc -l) if [ "$nroots" -lt 2 ]; then echo "[gate] accessor seam present for ${netex.schema.version} ($nseam classes);" echo "[gate] cross-root check skipped — only $nroots version root exists." else echo "[gate] accessor seam complete for ${netex.schema.version} ($nseam classes, $nroots roots)" fi
